page.overview:
Who is Cylostra Direfin?

Cylostra Direfin, feared as the "Siren of the Storm" and the "Mistress of the Deep," is the self-obsessed Madame-Captain of the ghostly galleon known as the Lamprey. A powerful sea witch and malignant Undead spirit, Cylostra is the emissary of Stromfels, the god of the hazards of the sea, having struck a pact with him in exchange for immortality and sea-magic in the midst of an untimely demise brought about by her own hubris.

The former diva of Bretonnia is driven to complete the performance she died trying to fulfill among the Asur, and intends to do so by sinking Ulthuan and drowning the High Elven Phoenix King beneath the waves. She will not stop until all the mortal world has heard her deathly, siren song.

The infamous Siren of the Storm was not always a terror of the deep. Her legend has it that in decades, or perhaps centuries past, Madame Cylostra Direfin was once a Bretonnian songstress. More than that, she was the favourite court singer of not just Bretonnian royalty, being a renowned performer for kings, rich nobles and eminent stately guests, but of the Royarch of Bretonnia himself.

Cylostra was a fierce lady, a prima donna of considerable size and temper who never accepted anything less than getting her own way. Her sense of self-importance could not be understated -- whenever she travelled across the lands of chivalry to give her performances, she did so with a huge entourage made up of servants and attendants who would cater to her every whim.
